features: KITCHEN ARSENAL: As much as a gourmet chef might make use of exotic ingredients and unique spices, you still can’t get very far in any recipe without needing the basics: salt and pepper. Equipping your kitchen with a good set of salt and pepper shakers will be a long-term investment for the future, and you can enjoy using them every day for years to come.

VINTAGE ATMOSPHERE: Bring an old-style flavor to your table setting with this Ceramic Mason Salt and Pepper Shaker Set. These shakers are made with beautiful ceramic and have a charming vintage Mason jar look. These vintage shakers feature an ergonomic form for easy shaking, and you'll want to keep these great looking shakers out all day long and enjoy them as a centerpiece.

PERFECT PRESENT: These shakers make a perfect present for your friends, relatives or workmates for them to have a place for their spices and complete their kitchen arsenal. It applies old-style flavor and charm to their everyday gathering.

DISHWASHER SAFE: As you may be aware of, these shakers has been treated at some stage of the production process, to ensure that the prolonged high temperatures of the dishwasher, and highly effective detergents, don’t compromise the items and cause them any damage. Ceramics are made dishwasher safe through slow cooling to even out any stresses within its structure, making it more equipped to deal with temperature changes.
INCLUDES: (1) Blue Ceramic Mason Jar Salt Shaker and (1) Blue Ceramic Mason Jar Pepper Shaker
